cover.title:
让模型自己管上下文
32K 预算下从 21% 升到 56%
cover.dek: NVIDIA 的新论文让模型自己决定何时压缩、压缩什么。GPT 6.1 在 32K 预算下从 21% 升到 56%，Kimi 的输入 token 最多少了 41%。
cover.title_en:
Letting models manage their own context
GPT 6.1 goes from 21% to 56% at 32K
cover.dek_en: NVIDIA's new paper lets the model decide when to compress and what to compress. At a 32K budget GPT 6.1 climbs from 21% to 56%, and Kimi uses up to 41% fewer input tokens.

stickers.title: 论文角
stickers.text: Autoresearch 消融显示，保留可访问的历史记录比滚动摘要效果好。
stickers.text_en: An Autoresearch ablation finds that keeping an accessible history beats rolling summaries.
